designationHistory.name: Cottonwood Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 8149 setting apart about 1,013 acres in McHenry County, North Dakota, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: Both sources carry the same order text; no FWS document with the date was found. Renamed Cottonwood Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 8149
